purpose: User-requested finite q3/q4 experiment on the same manufacturing cohort; only path_budget changes relative to q2
refit_policy: One fixed final training set per configuration/seed, used unchanged for both evaluation years. No yearly retraining.
M2: Reuse all-sector M2, never label it manufacturing-trained
primary_aggregation: Per-year and pooled metrics from individual seeds, then mean/range. Pooled computed from concatenated predictions. Seed ensemble secondary for matched aggregation with M2.
alerts: Quarter-specific rank Top20/25, tie-break sample_id; no test-tuned threshold or recalibration
censoring: Inherited source_consistent_endpoint_weights and marginal reverse KM; unresolved endpoints zero evaluation weight but retained in ranks
stopping: Run q3/q4 three seeds each once, preserve all results. This is explicit post-exposure algorithm exploration; no blind/confirmatory claim and no additional optimization.
known_limitations: historical PIT and derived-input vintages not certified
quality defaults and followup semantics PROVISIONAL
2022-2024 previously exposed, never claim blind holdout
M2 representation/budget differs; unrestricted is same-backend reference
industry_rule: Match industry to the financial report (code, Accper) actually selected by the previous frozen origin input. Typrep A. Use Indcd for Accper before 2023-05-01, Indcd1 thereafter. Manufacturing is valid C-prefixed numeric division. Missing industry excluded, no current-code fallback. Industry version availability is unverified: retrospective report-linked proxy, not certified PIT.
comparators: q2 manufacturing frozen, matched configuration except path order
unrestricted manufacturing frozen, unmatched candidate/cut settings
explanation: All exact components through degree q; no truncation to pairs. Report order-specific function count, spatial cells and support, exact reconstruction and seed stability.
